title: Integrated Brochure & Syllabus System (IBASS) — e-syllabus index and per-subject syllabus PDFs
subject: Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry
limitations: IBASS is a JavaScript SPA: every route (including /assets/uploads/Mathematics.pdf, Physics.pdf, Chemistry.pdf) returns the index.html shell (HTTP 200, text/html, 1257 bytes) — not PDF bytes. The discovered API (ibass-api.jamb.gov.ng/api, React-axios base) returns {"error":true,...} on GET for /api/e-syllabus, /api/brochure-courses, /api/materials without a documented request body; no per-subject syllabus PDF bytes obtained. A URL returning HTTP 200 is not proof of document retrieval.
notes: Historical observations (2026-10-10, 2026-10-14) consistent: hashed asset URLs, no per-subject PDF found. Next action: identify the API request contract (e.g., from the SPA bundle) or obtain documents via another official channel.
